name: zinc finger CCCH-type containing 7B

function.text: ZC3H7B encodes zinc finger CCCH domain-containing protein 7B. Annotated molecular activities include miRNA binding. It participates in post-transcriptional regulation of gene expression and miRNA processing.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Endometrial stromal sarcoma; Ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
